_doc: How each weapon's attack looks and sounds (read by src/tactical/view/weapon_fx.gd; Fx draws it, greybox plays it). 'weapons': weapon id (data/rules/weapons.json, plus the built-ins 'brawling' and 'martial_arts') -> kind. 'skills': fallback by the weapon's skill when the id is not listed. Anything unresolved is 'gun' (the firearm pipeline: per-class muzzle flash from Fx.FLASH, bullet streak, gunshot by class). 'kinds': visual = gun | air | dart | microwave | sonic | arc | flame | rail | arrow | lob | rocket | throw | melee; shot = the sound on firing ('' = gunshot by class, guns only), vol its level in dB (default 0); swing / hit = melee sounds; impact = a sound where the projectile lands; flash = an Fx.FLASH class to borrow (scaled by flash_scale); brass = casings eject; charge = seconds of wind-up (charge sound first) before the shot; clip = the melee animation; slash = draw a blade arc; col = the effect's colour; book = what it is (CPR core page) and why it looks this way.

gun.book: Firearms (p.91-94): muzzle flash per class, bullet streak, gunshot by class.

gun_malorian.book: Malorian Arms 3516 (p.348): a 5d6 hand cannon, bigger than any very heavy pistol: the same bullet, a fatter flash and a deep, booming report.

gun_helix.book: Tsunami Arms Helix (p.349): autofire-only, 20 rounds an attack: rifle rounds with an electric spin-up whine over the report, cyan-tinted streaks.

gun_hurricane.book: Constitution Arms Hurricane (p.348): a drum-fed ROF 2 shotgun: the shotgun's blast, heavier and lower.

air.book: Air Pistol (p.347): a paintball pistol loaded with acid balls: no fire, a soft pneumatic puff, a slow visible pellet that splats.

dart.book: Dartgun (p.348): fires non-basic arrows (poison, sleep darts): a quiet thwip and a visible dart, no flash.

microwave.book: Microwaver (p.348-349): a microwave projector that fries cyberware: no round, a wavering heat-distortion beam and an electrical hum.

sonic.book: Shrieker (p.349): a sonic pistol that bursts eardrums: shockwave rings travelling down the line and a piercing screech.

stun_gun.book: Stun Gun (p.349): a less-lethal pistol on battery packs: a crackling electric arc to the target and a zap.

flame.book: Flamethrower (p.348): incendiary shells only, sets targets burning: a roaring cone of fire with heat haze, no bullet.

rail.book: Rhinemetall EMG-86 (p.349): an electromagnetic railgun that ignores light armour: a capacitor whine builds, then a bright instant rail line and a heavy crack.

bow.book: Bows (p.94): a string twang and a visible arrow on a shallow arc.

crossbow.book: Crossbows (p.94, p.342): a mechanical clack-twang and a bolt, flatter and faster than an arrow.

launcher.book: Grenade launchers (p.94; Cowboy U-56 p.349): a hollow thump and a visible grenade arcing onto the target, bursting there.

rocket.book: Rocket launcher (p.94): backblast, a rocket on a smoke trail, an explosion on arrival.

thrown_blade.book: Thrown melee weapon (p.177): a throw whoosh and a spinning blade.

thrown_grenade.book: Thrown grenade (p.177): tossed by hand (the blast itself is Fx.grenade_arc + explosion).

melee_blade.book: Light melee (p.92: combat knife, tomahawk; Wolvers): a whoosh and a slicing hit, a blade arc.

melee_blunt.book: Medium / heavy melee (p.92: bat, crowbar, lead pipe, spiked bat): a whoosh and a dull thud.

melee_heavy.book: Very heavy melee (p.92: sledgehammer, chainsaw, naginata): a slow, heavy whoosh and a crushing thud.

melee_mono.book: Kendachi Mono-Three (p.348): a crystal monoblade: a singing high whoosh and a clean, glowing cut.

melee_stun.book: Stun Baton (p.349): a less-lethal shock club: the swing, then a crackling electric arc on contact.

melee_glove.book: Battleglove (p.347): an armoured gauntlet: a punch with a metal-backed thud.

melee_fist.book: Brawling (p.176): a quick whoosh and a punch.

melee_martial.book: Martial Arts (p.178): strikes like Brawling; the same quick whoosh and punch.
